STEM Fair Mixer — students walking a venue, and the delays that hold them

Students walking a five-location STEM fair, and the delays that hold them once they arrive.

What to watch for

The line is the corridor and the dots on it are students in transit, but the fair is in the room below. Where they stop is a bare delay with no geometry of its own — a storage bound to that delay's name is what draws it. A conversation runs about eighteen minutes against a few seconds of walking, so almost everyone is standing still.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (156 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
